findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "get_ayurveda_qualities" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Return the twenty gunas, the qualities of Ayurveda, as the ten opposed pairs the commentaries spell out, each member with the single action word attached to it,…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "ayurveda" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_ayurveda_constitution · Public sink: post_ayurveda_constitution, post_ayurveda_dinacharya, post_ayurveda_ritucharya.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_ayurveda_constitution · Public sink: post_ayurveda_constitution, post_ayurveda_dinacharya, post_ayurveda_ritucharya

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
